description: Make printable flash cards to cut out and fold: a word or question on the front and its meaning or answer on the back (vocabulary, sight words, facts, another language), picture cards, or math fact cards (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division). Up to 100 cards, 4, 6 or 8 a page.

answer_on_front.description: Swap the sides: print the back (the meaning or answer) on the front.

cards.description: words: the cards, each a front and a back. pictures: picture names in "front" only.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

fact.description: Math decks: which number’s facts, e.g. "7" for the 7s, or "all".

kind.description: words (front and back you write), pictures (the site’s pictures with their names), or a math fact deck.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "Science Vocabulary". Keep it short.

name: make_flashcards

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Flash cards
